annotations.title: Read an app's phone system connection

description: Read-only. The phone system connection of an app: provider, status (pending = link made and no token typed yet, connected, error), the public settings, whether a token is stored (never the token), the board mapping, the last sync result and the last error. connection is null when nothing was started.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: get_telephony_connection
